title: Petra and the Horizon
author: Odile Joubert
blurb: Bram Marchetti, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
